mainEntity.name: How much does AI SEO for pool contractors typically cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: The cost of AI SEO for pool contractors can vary significantly based on the scope of services, the competitiveness of your market, and the depth of AI tools employed. Factors influencing pricing include the number of keywords targeted, content creation needs, technical SEO improvements, and reporting frequency. Generally, pricing can range from a few hundred to several thousand dollars per month. It's often structured as a monthly retainer, with custom packages available to suit different business sizes and objectives. A consultation can provide a precise quote.
